messages: anya (infra): heads-up: eu-west2 ephemeral nodes showing attach failures, suspect NVMe queue exhaustion after cleanup run. metrics-bot: alert /alerts/ephemeral-iops-spike eu-west2 (iops ~4.8x baseline). tom (eng-infra): janitor ran at 02:05 with fast window (5m) from recent rollout (PR#4621). drew (sre): logs: 'nvme submission queue full' and multiple 'device busy' during kube attach. anya (infra): impact: ~10 pending gpu attaches, several CI jobs stuck. cleanup-bot: pausing janitor for label=ephemeral-eu-west2 per request anya. tom (eng-infra): rolling scrub cadence back to 18m via cronjob patch. command: `kubectl -n infra patch cronjob janitor-cleaner --patch '{"spec":{"schedule":"*/18 * * * *"}}'`. drew (sre): applying host-level throttle on nvme nr_requests on three hosts; smartctl shows no failing drives. anya (infra): bumping provisioner attach timeout 30s->75s in runtime config. tom (eng-infra): follow-ups: make janitor size-aware + backoff when iops>threshold, add tempfile-churn metric. metrics-bot: runbook /runbooks/io-surge-ephemeral.md added (draft). anya (infra): status: janitor paused, throttle applied, attach queue draining. closing incident unless iops > 2x baseline. :white_check_mark:
